verdicts.reason: A is broken: the Shop Flavours CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill crammed against the Honey Rosemary pill at top-left, the three flavour pills are split across opposite ends of the banner with the legal text wedged between Cucumber Mint and Blood Orange, and SOLSTICE now sits under the headline. B is also flawed but holds together better. Its CTA is oversized and pushed into the left edge so it competes with the headline, the logo still sits below the headline, the subcopy is squeezed into a two-line wrap beside the pills, and the legal text floats over a mostly empty right third. Still, B keeps the pills together as one row and the copy stays readable.
